gameEditor.antiCheat: Don't use SavePoint with online games that have anti-cheat. Changed game files can get your account flagged.
gameEditor.artwork.appId.helper: Only used to find artwork. It's the number after /app/ in the game's Steam store address.
gameEditor.artwork.appId.label: Steam app ID (optional)
gameEditor.artwork.appId.saveFirst: Save to look up the new ID.
gameEditor.artwork.label: Artwork
gameEditor.artwork.pickTitle: Choose a picture for this game
gameEditor.cloudSaves.on.gog: Cloud saves are on for this game in GOG Galaxy. Galaxy keeps saves that SavePoint changes, but brings back saves that SavePoint removed, so going back to before a save may not stick. To avoid that, turn off cloud saves for this game in Galaxy.
gameEditor.cloudSaves.on.steam: Steam Cloud is on for this game. Steam keeps saves that SavePoint changes, but brings back saves that SavePoint removed, so going back to before a save may not stick. If Steam asks which saves to keep, choose "Local Save".
gameEditor.cloudSaves.unknown: If this game's store syncs cloud saves, it can bring back saves that SavePoint removed. Turn off cloud saves for this game in its store to be safe.

A small file left in each folder marks it.}}
gameEditor.consent.title: {count, plural, one {Confirm this folder} other {Confirm these folders}}
gameEditor.discard.message: Going back now throws away the changes you haven't saved.
gameEditor.discard.title: Discard your changes?
gameEditor.export.successUnsaved: Exported the saved version of {name}. Changes you haven't saved aren't in the file.
gameEditor.external.label: Where the saves live
gameEditor.external.missingNote: No saves folder is set yet. Many games only create it the first time you play, often in Documents or Saved Games. Until you add it, snapshots cover the game's files but not your saves.
gameEditor.ignorePaths.defaultNote: New games leave out logs and crash reports, which a game rewrites while it runs and SavePoint would take for a game update. Remove a rule to keep them in your snapshots.
gameEditor.ignorePaths.savesKept: {count, plural, one {The rule {rules} now applies} other {The rules {rules} now apply}} to the game's own folder only, so your saves stay in your snapshots.
gameEditor.ignorePaths.savesUnchecked: {count, plural, one {The rule {rules} now applies} other {The rules {rules} now apply}} to the game's own folder only, because SavePoint couldn't check your saves folder. {count, plural, one {It is} other {They are}} listed under "Files to leave out of the game's own folder" in Edit game.
gameEditor.ignorePaths.label: Files to leave out of both folders
gameEditor.ignorePaths.helper: SavePoint never copies or replaces files that match. Use * for any name and ** for any folder. Don't add a rule that matches your saves, or profiles stop switching them.
gameEditor.ignorePaths.addAutomation: Add a rule for both folders
gameEditor.installIgnorePaths.label: Files to leave out of the game's own folder
gameEditor.installIgnorePaths.helper: SavePoint never copies or replaces matching files, such as logs and crash reports. These rules never apply to your saves folder. Use * for any name and ** for any folder.
gameEditor.installIgnorePaths.addAutomat: Add a rule for the game's own folder
gameEditor.import.success: Loaded {name} from the file. Nothing is saved until you choose Save changes.
gameEditor.install.browseAutomation: Browse for the game's install folder
gameEditor.install.label: Where the game is installed

gameEditor.launch.steamHelper: The number is in the address of the game's Steam store page.
gameEditor.launch.steamStartNote: Games installed by Steam on Linux usually need Steam to start them. Through Steam is the safer choice.
gameEditor.launch.steamWarning: Steam may update the game right after SavePoint puts your version back. {os, select, windows {Running the .exe} macos {Running the app} other {Running the program}} avoids that.
gameEditor.launchArgs.label: Extra command-line options

gameEditor.name.label: Name
gameEditor.processName.helper: Used when the launcher closes itself before the game opens.
gameEditor.processName.label: Knowing when you've stopped playing
gameEditor.processName.linkWhy: This game starts through a link, so SavePoint can't see its program. Without the program name, you'll have to say when you've stopped playing.
gameEditor.reconnect.message: A game you removed used this folder, and its snapshots are still here. Reconnect to bring back its profiles and snapshots, or start fresh and leave them.
gameEditor.reconnect.title: This folder has snapshots from before
gameEditor.folderMismatch.title: Is this the right folder?
gameEditor.folderMismatch.message: The {role, select, install {game install folder} external {saves folder} other {folder}} you picked, {path}, holds only {presentCount} of the {recordedCount} files in its latest snapshot. If it is the wrong folder, switching profiles or discarding changes could delete files that belong to something else there.
